purpose: Optional aggregate-only asset-level scoring fixture for post-launch revenue-validation decisions. Copy to asset-signal-scores.json after an approved public launch only, then enter 0..3 scores from public aggregate template-request/commercial-fit label counts and allowed manual observations. Do not include issue bodies, authors, comments, usernames, emails, IPs, client names, contact details, quotes, invoices, payment data, logs, screenshots, or confidential/security-sensitive information.

scoring_scale.0: No visible public-safe demand for this asset yet
scoring_scale.1: Weak signal, such as a star/fork/open issue without asset-specific request evidence
scoring_scale.2: Some signal, such as one public-safe template request or repeated aggregate interest for this asset category
scoring_scale.3: Meaningful signal, such as commercial-fit label evidence or multiple public-safe requests pointing to this asset category

allowed_source: Aggregate public counters and label/category totals only after APPROVAL-HANDOFF-FIELDS.json validates a concrete approved public URL and the package is live.
forbidden_source: No analytics, referrer logs, issue bodies, comments, author names, usernames, emails, IPs, contact details, client names, confidential/security-sensitive details, quotes, invoices, payment/KYC data, private inboxes, forms, account creation, posting, or spend.
